# Support for Senatla Ops

Senatla Ops is an internal operational solution delivered by Sankofa Digital Studio for Senatla Trading.

## Getting Help

### 1. Authoritative Documentation
Before opening an issue or contacting support, consult the official documentation portal:
- [Senatla Ops Documentation Portal](https://sankofa-digital-studio.github.io/senatla-ops-internal-automation-solution/)
- [Release Notes & Architectural Decision Records](https://sankofa-digital-studio.github.io/senatla-ops-internal-automation-solution/#releases)
- [Operational Runbooks & Handover](https://sankofa-digital-studio.github.io/senatla-ops-internal-automation-solution/#runbooks)

### 2. Operational Issues & Bug Reports
- If you encounter a software bug or unexpected behavior in a deployed environment, please check existing GitHub issues on the project board.
- Open a bug report using the structured issue template: [New Bug Report](https://github.com/Sankofa-Digital-Studio/senatla-ops-internal-automation-solution/issues/new?template=bug.yml).

### 3. Change Requests & Feature Proposals
- To propose architectural extensions or new field operations workflows, submit a feature request via: [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/Sankofa-Digital-Studio/senatla-ops-internal-automation-solution/issues/new?template=feature.yml).

### 4. Direct Engineering Escalation
For mission-critical production blockers or deployment emergencies:
- Lead Developer: Rubin Thoso Ntula ([thosontula@gmail.com](mailto:thosontula@gmail.com))
- Sankofa Digital Studio Operations: [ops@sankofadigital.co.za](mailto:ops@sankofadigital.co.za)
